introduction: More electricity has been generated through wind and solar power than from coal power plants for the

vocabulary.definition: to be more than or to exceed
vocabulary.example: The renewable energy generation surpasses coal for the first time.

vocabulary.definition: where most of something comes from
vocabulary.example: Renewables have become the world's primary source of electricity.
Solar and wind power has grown faster than electricity demand this year.

vocabulary.definition: to be greater than a particular number or amount
vocabulary.example: Renewable energy has exceeded coal in electricity generation.

vocabulary.definition: to go past something by being a greater amount or degree
vocabulary.example: Renewable energy sources overtake coal in electricity production.

vocabulary.definition: to satisfy a need or requirement
vocabulary.example: 100% of the increase in electricity demand has been met by renewable sources.
